name: Alga PSA Ticket Triage
description: Reading the Alga PSA service desk: open queues by board, status, priority and assignee; stale, unassigned and aging tickets; a single ticket's full history (comments with internal notes, logged time, linked assets); finding the ticket behind an RMM alert by external link; and knowledge articles that match a problem. Read-only: proposes ticket changes, never makes them.
